title: Money Desk record
description: One pick, arbitrage, or reality-check verdict exchanged between Samuel's bots via /home/box/shared/money-desk. Proposals only: no record ever authorizes a bet.

id.description: Optional unique id; default = file name without .json

source_bot.description: Bot name and/or agent id, e.g. 'money bot (568853df-...)'

ticker.description: Kalshi ticker exactly as the API returns it (official strike), e.g. KXBTCD-26NOV1017-T74249.99

window_start_et.description: For 15-min windows: start time ET. The window's NAME/time is its END.

settlement_source.description: Copied from the rules text, e.g. 'CF Benchmarks BRTI 60s avg', 'The Weather Company CLINYC'

kalshi_shard.description: exchange_index from the market (0 general, 1 combos, 2 crypto/commodities, 3 sports)

depth_at_price.description: Contracts (Kalshi) or known limit ($) at this price

side.description: Headline side, e.g. 'NO' or 'arb: KXNBAGAME...-NYK YES + FanDuel MIL ML'

price.description: Headline entry price (Kalshi dollars) or combined cost per $1 payout for an arb

fair_prob.description: Model/no-vig probability the side wins; null for pure arbs

fair_prob_source.description: e.g. 'DK no-vig (power method)', 'lognormal 120m realized vol', 'NWS forecast + obs'

pct_after_fees.description: Arb: guaranteed return % on total stake after fees

fee_dollars.description: Total taker fees for the suggested size, Kalshi = ceil(0.07*C*P*(1-P)) to the cent

method.description: e.g. 'quarter Kelly capped at $5', 'arb equal-payout split'

transfer_needed.description: Describe any shard transfer; never executed without Samuel's yes

verdict.description: PASS = worth showing Samuel; FAIL = do not bet; WATCH = re-check at a trigger

watch_trigger.description: For WATCH: what would flip it, e.g. 'ask <= 0.85' or 'after 8:30 CPI'

data_timestamps.description: Name -> ISO time of each data pull, e.g. {"kalshi": "...", "kraken_spot": "...", "draftkings": "..."}

expires_at.description: After this the record is stale and must not be acted on (usually market close or quote time + 15 min)

reviewed_by.description: Filename of the reality-check record that reviewed this one

approval.description: Only Samuel changes this; bots never set approved_by_samuel themselves
